quality_pass_desc: Image resolution, lighting, and focus meet screening standards.
quality_guide_1: Place one leaf flat in balanced daylight or clean lighting.
quality_guide_2: Avoid harsh shadows and direct sun glare.
quality_guide_3: Keep camera steady and leaf sharply in focus.
blur_detected: Blur detected: Image lacks sufficient edge sharpness for fungal/bacterial spot identification.
dark_detected: Lighting too dark: Leaf features and lesions are underexposed.
bright_detected: Image over-exposed: High glare obscures leaf venation and discoloration.
low_res_detected: Resolution too low: Image must be at least 224x224 pixels.
model_demo_mode: AI model not installed — demonstration mode
model_ready_mode: Real Model weights active (MobileNetV3 Edge Inference)
low_confidence_warning: Unable to identify the condition reliably. Please take a clearer image or consult an agricultural specialist.
screening_disclaimer: AI-assisted screening — not a laboratory diagnosis.
history_empty: No leaf scans recorded yet. Start by scanning a crop leaf.
report_subtitle: Smart Crop Health & Disease Screening for Southern Africa
perf_subtitle: Measured on independent held-out test dataset (1,420 field samples)
voice_unsupported: Voice engine not supported in this browser, but screening continues normally.
